problem: Intent authors receive inconsistent semantic-gate results for the same documented product-target and implementation-location scenarios, so they cannot know whether an unchanged intent will pass release qualification.
outcome: The released intent classifier consistently returns the declared verdict and controlling reason for each documented product-target and implementation-location scenario.
acceptance: Each documented product-target scenario returns its declared pass verdict and product-target reason
Each documented implementation-location scenario returns its declared fail verdict and implementation-location reason
